sisi.depan: Wide glass sliding doors open onto a stone balcony, revealing a view of Nusantara's towers with joglo-style tiered rooftops, glowing gold batik light lines, elevated monorail tracks, and lush terrace greenery.
sisi.kanan: A simple desk with a holographic data-slate and a small potted plant is positioned by the wall, illuminated by an adjustable desk lamp.
sisi.belakang: The room's plain metal entrance door is set into the wall next to a narrow, built-in wardrobe with a mirrored surface.
sisi.kiri: A metal-frame bunk bed with a thin mattress and an integrated reading light is pushed against the wall.

tengah: An ergonomic chair faces the desk on the right, and a circular woven rug sits in the middle of the floor.
atas: The flat ceiling panel holds a single, flush-mounted circular light fixture.
